name: My Boyfriend is a Martian
source:
Meet Katy, your average small-town gal. After a grueling day at work, she's just trying to make it back home. Little does she know, the universe has some surprises in store for her during her long journey. Get ready for an adventure that's out of this world!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899750/My_Boyfriend_is_a_Martian%EF%B8%8F/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
认识一下凯蒂吧，一个再普通不过的小镇姑娘。结束了一天累死人的工作后，她只想平平安安赶回家。然而她浑然不知，宇宙早已在她漫长的归途上备好了几份意想不到的惊喜。准备好迎接一场超乎尘世的奇妙冒险吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899750/My_Boyfriend_is_a_Martian%EF%B8%8F/]Steam[/url]]
